title: Fourth moment excluding the mean coefficient
statement: For any function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, its vector Fourier fourth moment minus $(\mathbb{E}_x f(x))^4$ equals the sum of the fourth powers of its vector Fourier coefficients over all nonzero indices $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, where $x$ is uniform on the cube.
